name: Animated Wallpaper
author: duarte-gui (fork of jacobobb/omarchy-animated-wallpaper)
description: Play a folder of videos as the desktop wallpaper with mpvpaper, controlled from the Omarchy 4 bar.

barWidget.description: Turns a folder of videos into a looping desktop wallpaper. Left click turns it on or off, right click picks the folder, middle click skips to the next video.

schema.label: Video folder
schema.description: Folder whose videos play as the wallpaper, one after the other, looping forever. Right-clicking the bar button opens a folder picker that fills this in. Supports mp4, webm, mkv, mov, avi, gif and the other formats mpv knows as video; subfolders are not included.

schema.label: Wallpaper on
schema.description: Whether the animated wallpaper is playing. Left-clicking the bar button flips this, and it is remembered, so the video comes back on its own after you log in again.

schema.label: Playback order
schema.description: sequential plays the folder in name order; shuffle mixes it up every time the wallpaper starts.

schema.label: Pause when covered
schema.description: Pause the video while windows cover the whole desktop, so it costs no GPU time when you cannot see it.

schema.label: Extra mpv options
schema.description: Space-separated mpv options added to the defaults, for example panscan=1.0 to fill the screen without black bars, or speed=0.5.
